title: A hotel lobby, the check-in rush
intro: Between 15:20 and 15:50 arrivals pile up at the desk. A second desk can be opened.

decision.why: Louder than a room for rest should be.
At the rate guests are joining, the queue will pass four within six minutes. A second desk now keeps it from forming.
